newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby soybean basis tumbles.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Nearby soybean basis tumbles.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf nearby soybean basis values were sharply lower on Friday with the recent rise in prices diminishing already flagging export demand.
Dealers said offers for June and July delivery were down around eight cents a bushel at 20 cents over CBOT July.
They noted the basis collapse came around mid-morning when CBOT July futures touched their 30-cent upper limit. The nearby contract closed 13 cents up at $8.54-1/2.
Nearby soft red winter wheat basis values were up around five cents as wet conditions continued to delay harvesting in southern states. Hard red winter basis values were steady.
Corn basis values were little changed in quiet trade.
